limitations: Sample limited to university students, potentially affecting generalizability to other age groups or populations with different cultural backgrounds.
The virtual environment, despite being immersive, may not fully replicate the reality of a fire emergency, potentially limiting external validity.
The specific time interval of two weeks between consecutive exposures for the threshold effect requires further investigation for different intervals.

The degree of reality experienced by participants could be further enhanced by introducing additional human senses and dynamic scenarios (e.g., real walking, smell of fire, dynamic obstacles, human group interaction).
